clue.text: Intend to take positive action in underhand affair

parts.note: underhand means mean, in the sense of nasty and low
an affair is a business, as in 'a strange business'

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to act decisively over some shady dealing.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom signals serious resolve to act, being determined rather than merely talking.

clue.text: Low toll for berth

parts.note: to low is to moo, as cattle do
a bell's toll is its ring

explanation.surface: A cow's lowing and a bell's tolling heard near a ship's berth.
explanation.definitionFit: A berth is a place where a boat is tied up, which is a synonym.

clue.text: Notice one model is fat

parts.note: a notice in a paper is an ad, short for advertisement
the Roman numeral I is one
to model is to pose for an artist

explanation.surface: An observer remarks that a particular fashion model is overweight.
explanation.definitionFit: Adipose is the technical adjective for fatty body tissue, a synonym for fat.

clue.text: One living luxuriously in German city holding exam finally irrelevant

indicators.note: the city's name holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: Bonn, the former West German capital
a viva is an oral examination

indicators.note: finally picks out only the closing letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A wealthy resident of a German city treats a final exam as unimportant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' puts the exam inside the city's name, between its two Ns; a viva is an oral exam, common in British universities.
explanation.definitionFit: A bon vivant is a person who enjoys good food and the high life, so lives luxuriously.

clue.text: Small stem bearing flowers? Any number out of season

indicators.note: out of means the named letter is taken away from the season

parts.note: spring is one of the four seasons
N is the algebraic symbol for any number

explanation.surface: A gardener wonders whether a flowering shoot can be found at any time of year.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprig is a small shoot or twig of a plant, often with flowers or leaves.

clue.text: Falls once more, knocked over by gunmen

indicators.note: in a down clue, knocking a word over turns it upside down so it reads backwards

parts.note: once more means again
RA, the Royal Artillery, are the army's gunners

explanation.surface: Someone tumbles again after being shot at by armed men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked over' suits a down clue, where the word is toppled and so read from the bottom up; the Royal Artillery are the British Army's gunners.
explanation.definitionFit: Niagara is the famous set of waterfalls on the US-Canada border, the example meant by Falls.

clue.text: Part of leg found on archaeological expedition causes a commotion

parts.note: the shin is the front of the lower leg
an archaeological excavation is called a dig

explanation.surface: A leg bone unearthed by archaeologists causes a stir.
explanation.definitionFit: A shindig is a noisy party or disturbance, so a commotion.

clue.text: Bishop, say — drink that's sweet

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
to say is to utter
Scotch is whisky, a drink

explanation.surface: A clergyman is offered a sweet drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bishop, say' looks like an example (a bishop as a sort of something), but Bishop and say are separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Butterscotch is a brittle toffee made from butter and brown sugar, a kind of sweet.

clue.text: Idealistic reformer from university, leading Scotsman

parts.note: leading means top, first in rank
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A visionary from academia is described as a prominent Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: A utopian is a person who dreams of an ideal society, an idealistic reformer.

clue.text: Cash in study is dipped into by European

parts.note: to read a subject at university is to study it

indicators.note: is dipped into by means the next piece goes inside the word is

explanation.surface: Money in someone's den is pilfered by a foreigner.
explanation.definitionFit: Readies is British slang for ready money, banknotes or cash.

clue.text: Son had plenty on nobbled horse

indicators.note: a nobbled horse has been tampered with, so these letters are tampered with and rearranged

explanation.surface: A man's son bet heavily on a racehorse that had been drugged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word. To nobble a racehorse is to drug or injure it to stop it winning.
explanation.definitionFit: The Shetland pony is a small breed of horse from the Scottish islands.

clue.text: Capital excursion round the Italian retreats

parts.note: an excursion is a trip
O is round in shape

indicators.note: something that retreats goes backwards, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: il is the Italian for the

explanation.surface: A trip out to an Italian city's outskirts is called off.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripoli is the capital city of Libya.

clue.text: Haughty and extremely excitable man of high rank abroad

parts.note: grand can mean haughty and superior in manner

indicators.note: extremely picks out the first and last letters of the next word

explanation.surface: A highly-strung, proud man is described as a foreign aristocrat.
explanation.definitionFit: A grandee is a Spanish or Portuguese nobleman of the top rank, hence the abroad.

clue.text: Profligate nicking grand, the villain

indicators.note: nicking means taking in, so the profligate holds the next letter

parts.note: a roué is a dissolute, profligate man
G is slang for a grand, a thousand pounds

explanation.surface: A dissolute man steals a thousand pounds, the scoundrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A rogue is a dishonest person or rascal, so a villain.

clue.text: What we call a port is a spirit

definitions.meaning: the English name for the Russian port of Arkhangelsk
an angel of high rank, a heavenly spirit

explanation.definitionFit: English speakers name the White Sea port after its Russian form, and the word also means a chief angel.

clue.text: Bird: no cracker, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A bird laments that there's no cracker for it.
explanation.definitionFit: The corncrake is a secretive rail found in grassland, a bird.

clue.text: The car twice broke down; that's its nature

indicators.note: broke down suggests coming apart, so these letters are rearranged
twice means the word car is used two times

explanation.surface: A motorist's car broke down twice, which is typical of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Character is the distinctive set of qualities of something, its nature.

clue.text: Sounds like a bag for a girl

indicators.note: sounds like says the letters are heard, not seen

parts.note: a net is a kind of bag, as for shopping or fish

explanation.surface: A clue to a girl's name that resembles a bag.
explanation.definitionFit: Annette is a girl's name, the example meant here.

clue.text: A nominated American film

parts.note: made can mean appointed or nominated, as in made a bishop

explanation.surface: An American film is up for an award.
explanation.walkthrough: Amadeus is the 1984 film about Mozart, which did win Oscars.
explanation.definitionFit: Amadeus is the Oscar-winning film about Mozart, an example of a film.

clue.text: Don is present

definitions.meaning: to don clothes is to dress in them
to present a play is to stage it

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to dress oneself in clothes and to stage a show.

clue.text: Old wife hemmed in by crowd shows courage

indicators.note: hemmed in by means surrounded, so the crowd surrounds the next pieces

parts.note: a press is a crowd or throng

explanation.surface: An elderly woman surrounded by a mob behaves bravely.
explanation.definitionFit: Prowess means skill or bravery, especially in battle, so courage.

clue.text: Rather quaint short word for a loudspeaker

parts.note: twee means excessively quaint or dainty

indicators.note: short means cut short, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a term is a word

explanation.surface: A precious, old-fashioned term is used for a speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A tweeter is a loudspeaker designed to reproduce high frequencies.

clue.text: Drank a rum, after time, leaving beer mug

indicators.note: after puts the anagram after the time letter
rum means odd or strange, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A drinker downs a rum and, after a while, leaves the pub with a mug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' looks like the drink, but is the anagram signal, turning DRANKA into ANKARD.
explanation.definitionFit: A tankard is a large beer mug, often of pewter with a handle.

clue.text: Old-fashioned old man penning note

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, so the next piece goes inside

parts.note: old man is slang for father, dad
te is a note in sol-fa

explanation.surface: An unfashionable father writes a short message.
explanation.definitionFit: Dated describes something out of date, so old-fashioned.

clue.text: Get beaten in competition and refuse to talk

indicators.note: in places the next piece inside the competition

parts.note: a cup is a competition
to get beaten is to lose

explanation.surface: Someone loses a contest and refuses to comment.
explanation.definitionFit: To close up is to fall silent and refuse to speak, an idiom.

clue.text: Difficult position in new constituency

parts.note: hot means new, as in hot off the press
a seat is a parliamentary constituency

explanation.surface: A candidate faces a tough spot in a newly drawn electoral district.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot seat is an uncomfortable position of responsibility, so a difficult one.

clue.text: Language in a match, last of season

parts.note: a vesta is a type of match

indicators.note: last of picks out the final letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Something is said in a match near the end of the season.
explanation.definitionFit: Avestan is the ancient Iranian language of the Zoroastrian scriptures.

clue.text: Piece of furniture actors' assistant from Cardiff used?

parts.note: Cardiff is the capital of Wales, so from Cardiff means Welsh
a dresser is a theatre assistant who helps actors with costumes

explanation.surface: A Welsh actor's dresser was used as a prop.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue names the actors' assistant first and where he is from second; read as a phrase, a dresser from Cardiff is the Welsh one.
explanation.definitionFit: A Welsh dresser is a sideboard with shelves above for displaying crockery.
